label: Advanced Imaging Suite
description: A suite of non-destructive tools used to visualize internal structures and surface textures at the microscopic level.

items.function: Creates a 3D X-ray map of the fossil's interior.
Uses electron beams to view surface morphology at 50,000x magnification.
Applies a microscopic gold-leaf layer to fossils for SEM readiness.

game_mechanics.internal_discovery: Scanning a 'Mystery Rock' might reveal a hidden embryo or a parasite inside a bone.
game_mechanics.cost_resource: These tools require 'Lab Credits' or 'Grant Money' to run, unlike the manual air-scribe.
